dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: The three most prominent mid-lateral structures consist of two closed 'O' shapes and one 'C' shape. These features exhibit sharp, high-intensity perimeters with a distinct gradient transition from a bright exterior line to a darker internal core.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: Density of solid high-intensity blobs is low; most high-intensity pixels are concentrated in the thin linear structures of the annuli. A minor cluster of small, high-intensity spots without internal gradients is visible in the cervico-dorsal region.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: The centroids of the three primary mid-lateral annuli form an obtuse triangle. The geometric relationship is defined by a horizontal axis between the posterior two centroids and an apex shifted anteriorly and ventrally.

other_distinctive_markers: A complex, high-contrast pattern resembling the character '5' or 'P' is visible on the upper dorsal flank, positioned anteriorly to the main cluster of rings.
